A '''Troig diplomat''' was at one point the owner of [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]], a [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T repair droid]]. The [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] eventually lost possession of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], which eventually appeared in a fire sale where buyers could purchase items for prices based on the mass of their acquisitions in [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. G2-9T was bought by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency.
